t: Right heart failure: A narrative review for emergency clinicians - ScienceDirect
s: May 25, 2022 - Right heart failure (RHF) is defined as impaired right ventricular (RV) contractility due to myocardial dysfunction, elevated pressures, or volume overload [1]. The true prevalence of RHF is challenging to estimate and depends on the definition of RHF in the individual study and the imaging study used to determine right ventricular function.
